description: Implementation of the Stability class functions for managing binder stability levels in Android, including methods for downgrading, marking, and checking stability levels of IBinder objects.

classes.name: Stability
classes.description: Class providing static methods to manage and query the stability levels of IBinder objects in Android.

methods.name: forceDowngradeToStability
methods.description: Downgrades the stability level of a local IBinder to a specified level.

methods.name: forceDowngradeToLocalStability
methods.description: Sets the stability level of a binder to local.

methods.name: forceDowngradeToSystemStability
methods.description: Sets the stability level of a binder to system.

methods.name: forceDowngradeToVendorStability
methods.description: Sets the stability level of a binder to vendor.

methods.name: markCompilationUnit
methods.description: Marks a binder as part of a compilation unit with local stability.

methods.name: markVintf
methods.description: Marks a binder with VINTF stability.

methods.name: markVndk
methods.description: Marks a binder with VENDOR stability.

methods.name: debugToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the stability level of a binder.

methods.name: requiresVintfDeclaration
methods.description: Checks if a binder requires VINTF declaration based on its stability.

methods.name: tryMarkCompilationUnit
methods.description: Attempts to mark a binder as part of a compilation unit without fatal errors.

methods.name: getLocalLevel
methods.description: Returns the local stability level based on build configuration.

methods.name: setRepr
methods.description: Sets the stability representation of a binder with flags for logging and downgrade allowance.

methods.name: getRepr
methods.description: Retrieves the stability representation of a binder.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if the provided stability level satisfies the required stability level.

methods.name: isDeclaredLevel
methods.description: Determines if a stability level is one of the declared levels (VENDOR, SYSTEM, VINTF).

methods.name: levelString
methods.description: Converts a stability level integer to a human-readable string.
